purpose: Presentation-only audit of the inclusive date boundaries implemented by the frozen v0.3.2 real-anchor cross-site estimators. This record reports an implementation limitation and does not change or re-estimate a frozen result.

calibration.role: Fixed weight fitting and calibration-residual centering.

interpretation: No post-anchor outcome is used in fitting. The 46-date calibration/pre overlap means that the displayed pre residuals are not an independent validation set. A separate non-overlapping analysis was not preregistered or incorporated into the frozen v0.3.2 evidence release.
